turns.content: Spring has finally arrived and I've been spending every weekend in the garden. It's been a real tonic.
There's something genuinely restorative about being outside with growing things. What are you planting?
Tomatoes, courgettes, and a load of herbs. I'm also trying runner beans for the first time.
Runner beans are rewarding — they produce a lot and look beautiful on the plant. Do you have a trellis ready?
I've got some canes but I think I need to build something more robust. They get quite tall.
They do. A simple A-frame with horizontal strings works really well. What's your soil situation like?
I spent last autumn adding a lot of compost so it should be in decent shape. I'm optimistic.
That preparation will really pay off. Courgettes especially love rich soil.
